_: What to SAY to the generator for a RAIL GLYPH, one row per rail button. `tools/art/icon.mts rail.json` asks and downloads; `portrait.mts <id> <png> 16 icons` puts one in `src/render/generated-icons.ts` at 16 across, which is the size the rail draws it. Four inks so a glyph stays a glyph: the rail is read at a glance, and a picture there is a sticker.
_how: Each is ONE emblem, bold and simple, filling the frame, drawn in stone-grey on nothing with one gold accent. Asked at 64 and imported at 16, so a mark under four generated pixels across is gone.
how: A single simple EMBLEM for a small stone button: one bold flat shape filling the frame, thick clean edges, drawn in pale bone-grey with one small warm gold accent, on a transparent background, seen straight on, no perspective. NOT detailed, NOT shaded, NOT textured, NOT a scene, NOT a character, NOT text, NOT a border, NOT a frame, NOT a circle round it, NOT thin lines, NOT several objects.

icons.say: a closed square-cornered BAG with a strap across the top and a gold clasp in the middle of the flap.
a blacksmith's ANVIL seen from the side, the horn to the left, the flat top edge lit gold.
a standing FIGURE in a plain hooded cloak, arms at the sides, faceless, a gold pin at the throat.
two crossed straight SWORDS, blades up, hilts down, a gold point where they cross.
a small hanging LANTERN on a short hook, the flame inside it gold.
an open BOOK seen from above, two pages, a gold ribbon marker down the middle.
a thick-walled cylindrical stone JAR with a flat lid, a gold band round the lid.
a plain six-toothed COG, a gold dot at its hub.

a single thick V-shaped ARROWHEAD pointing down, two thick bars meeting at a gold point at the bottom, alone in empty space with nothing round it. NOT a circle, NOT a disc, NOT a coin, NOT a badge, NOT a button, NOT a ring, NOT a background shape.
four right-angled corner BRACKETS at the four corners of the frame, pointing outward, the top-left one gold.
a small stone MASK with two empty eye holes, a gold mark on its brow.
